title: Day 1 · back in the tower, and the month's downtime
headline: Up the stair by 12:10 with 25 GP; 10 GP buys incense, and an owl familiar joins the tower.

bullets.label: Home
bullets.text: up the entrance stair to the tower at 12:10. The lamp is snuffed with about 1 h 50 min of oil left in its flask.

bullets.label: The trader
bullets.text: incense for Find Familiar, 10 GP. 15 GP left on him, 60 GP 2 SP 5 CP in the purse.

bullets.label: Find Familiar
bullets.text: cast as a Ritual from the spellbook (Ritual Adept: unprepared, +10 minutes, no casting check). An owl, a Fey spirit: it flies 12 m, sees in the dark and can scout rooms ahead and take the Help action. It never attacks.

bullets.label: Downtime
bullets.text: the rest of the month passes in the tower. A Long Rest puts everything back: 20/20 HP, all 3 Hit Dice, Arcane Recovery, Heroic Inspiration and the free Mage Armor. Mage Armor lapses.
